verdict.rationale: First-party docs reference a 'Model Improvement' setting in privacy settings and frame training use as something the user allows ('When you allow us to use your chats...'). Incognito chats are never used to improve Claude even when that setting is on, and Google Workspace connector data is never used for training. missing for 10: a direct how-to on toggling the Model Improvement setting (location, defaults, per-plan behavior), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the opt-out works as described.
